answer: The ocean holds work receipts rather than names, so the mirror of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the inlet of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, forfeited on duplicate submission, idle agents bleed standing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
